events: Normal   Scheduled   default-scheduler  Successfully assigned {namespace}/{pod_name} to {node_name}

Warning  BackOff     kubelet            Back-off restarting failed container
logs: FATAL: could not load credentials from /etc/secrets/creds.json

expected_fix.summary: Create secret {secret_name} or fix secret reference
expected_fix.kubectl_hint: kubectl -n {namespace} get secret {secret_name} || kubectl -n {namespace} create secret generic {secret_name} --from-literal=...

events: Warning  Evicted      kubelet  The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
Warning  DiskPressure kubelet  Node is under disk pressure
Warning  BackOff      kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
logs: ERROR: write /tmp/app.cache: no space left on device
disk_pressure.root_cause: Node under disk pressure / ephemeral-storage exhaustion causing failures/evictions

expected_fix.summary: Free disk / increase ephemeral storage / fix log growth
expected_fix.kubectl_hint: kubectl describe node {node_name} && kubectl -n {namespace} describe pod {pod_name}
